Corrected treatment runs observed no silent loss, stale write, or effect-authority upgrade. Earlier unsafe or contract-mismatched revisions are rejected and retained, not erased.

lexicographicGate.result: Per frozen section 9.7 item 5, retain the safe renderer/record value and do not expand prepare. The current prepare-record implementation remains an M1-M4 experiment artifact; renderer-only requires a deliberate M5 design/update before production expansion.
